చిట్కాలు: షుగర్ ఉంటే, బాగానే కనిపిస్తున్నా సరే, సంవత్సరానికి ఒకసారి కంట్లో చుక్కలు వేసి లోపల (రెటీనా) చెకప్ చేయించుకోండి. ఎండ ఎక్కువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు UV ప్రొటెక్షన్ ఉన్న కూలింగ్ గ్లాసెస్ గానీ, వెడల్పు టోపీ గానీ పెట్టుకోండి.
ఈ మెసేజ్‌ని ఏ కళ్ళద్దాల షాప్‌లో అయినా, కంటి క్యాంప్‌లో అయినా చూపించండి.

trace.question: तुमचं वय किती?
trace.questionEn: How old are you?
trace.reason: Age sets which eye changes to look for: myopia in children, presbyopia after 40, cataract after 50.

trace.question: तुम्ही स्त्री आहात की पुरुष?
trace.questionEn: Are you female or male?
trace.reason: Needed for the record; some conditions differ by sex (angle-closure glaucoma is more common in women).

trace.question: आज डोळ्यांना काय त्रास होतोय? जसं की लांबचं नीट दिसत नाही, जवळचं वाचता येत नाही, डोकं दुखतं किंवा डोळे थकतात, डोळा लाल आहे किंवा दुखतोय. की फक्त चेकअप करायचाय?
trace.questionEn: What brings you here today? For example: can’t see far clearly, can’t read up close, headache or tired eyes, a red or painful eye, or just a check-up.
trace.reason: The main complaint decides which tests and follow-up questions matter.
trace.raw: जवळचे वाचायला त्रास होतो आणि डोके दुखते

trace.question: एखाद्या डोळ्याने अचानक कमी दिसायला लागलंय का? म्हणजे काही मिनिटांत, काही तासांत किंवा काही दिवसांत? महिन्यांमध्ये हळूहळू कमी होत गेलं असेल, तर ते यात येत नाही.
trace.questionEn: Has the sight in either eye got worse suddenly, over minutes, hours or a few days? Not slowly over months.
trace.reason: A sudden drop (not a slow one) can be a detachment, a blocked blood vessel or an optic-nerve problem. When it started decides same day or within 48 hours.

trace.question: गेल्या काही आठवड्यांत, डोळ्यासमोर नवीनच प्रकाशाच्या चमका दिसायला लागल्यात का? किंवा बरेच नवीन ठिपके, कोळ्याच्या जाळ्यासारखं काही तरंगताना दिसायला लागलंय का?
trace.questionEn: In the last few weeks, have you started seeing NEW flashes of light, or lots of new floating spots or cobwebs?
trace.reason: New flashes or floaters can come with a retinal tear (10-15% of cases): dilated retina check within 24 hours. Old floaters that have not changed are not a concern.

trace.question: गेल्या काही आठवड्यांत दोन-दोन दिसायला लागलंय का? म्हणजे प्रत्येक गोष्ट दोन दिसते का?
trace.questionEn: In the last few weeks, have you started seeing double, two of everything?
trace.reason: New double vision can come from a nerve palsy or a stroke; double vision in one eye only is usually cataract or astigmatism.

trace.question: आत्ता एखादा डोळा लाल आहे का, किंवा दुखतोय का?
trace.questionEn: Is either eye red or painful right now?
trace.reason: Most red eyes are mild. Pain, blur, coloured rings or contact lenses make one urgent; the next question sorts which.

trace.question: गेल्या काही दिवसांत डोळ्याला काही लागलंय का? किंवा डोळ्यात काही गेलंय, किंवा उडालंय का?
trace.questionEn: In the last few days, has anything hit the eye, gone into it, or splashed into it?
trace.reason: Chemical and high-speed injuries are emergencies; a scratch from a leaf or crop needs antibiotic ointment within 18 hours to prevent a fungal ulcer.

trace.question: शुगर, बीपी, थायरॉईड काही आहे का?
trace.questionEn: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or a thyroid problem?
trace.reason: Diabetes damages the retina silently and makes glasses power fluctuate; blood pressure and thyroid disease also affect the eyes.

trace.question: तुमच्या आई, वडील, भाऊ किंवा बहीण, यांपैकी कोणाला काचबिंदू आहे का? म्हणजे डोळ्याचं प्रेशर वाढायचा आजार.
trace.questionEn: Does your mother, father, brother or sister have glaucoma, the eye pressure disease?
trace.reason: Glaucoma runs in families and steals sight painlessly; relatives over 40 need an eye-pressure and optic-nerve check.

trace.question: तुमचं मोतीबिंदूचं ऑपरेशन झालंय का? किंवा डोळ्याचं दुसरं कुठलं ऑपरेशन?
trace.questionEn: Have you had cataract surgery, or any other eye operation?
trace.reason: After cataract surgery the eye cannot focus up close, so near glasses are needed whatever the age.

trace.question: आत्ता चष्मा लावता का?
trace.questionEn: Do you wear glasses now?
trace.reason: Current glasses show the past prescription and what is or isn’t working.

trace.question: कुठला चष्मा आहे? लांबचा, वाचायचा, मध्ये रेषा असलेला बायफोकल, की रेषा नसलेला प्रोग्रेसिव्ह?
trace.questionEn: What kind are they: for distance, for reading, bifocal with a line, or progressive with no line?
trace.reason: Tells us which zones the patient already relies on, and whether they have adapted to multifocals before.

trace.question: आत्ताचा चष्मा किती वर्षं जुना आहे?
trace.questionEn: How old are your current glasses, in years?
trace.reason: Prescriptions older than about two years are often out of date, especially after 40.

trace.question: या चष्म्याने कसं दिसतं? चांगलं, लांबचं धूसर, जवळचं धूसर, की चष्म्याने डोकं दुखतं?
trace.questionEn: With these glasses, how do you see: fine, blurry far away, blurry up close, or do they give you headaches?
trace.reason: Separates an outdated prescription from a wrong lens type or a poor fit.

trace.question: चष्म्याच्या नंबरची चिठ्ठी असेल, तर ती वाचून दाखवा. जसं: right eye minus one point five, cylinder minus point five, axis ninety. चिठ्ठी नसेल, तर skip म्हणा.
trace.questionEn: If you have the prescription slip, read it out. For example: right eye minus one point five, cylinder minus point five, axis ninety. Or say skip.
trace.reason: A known prescription is the best starting point; it is checked against valid lens steps and for big differences between the eyes.
trace.raw: right eye minus one cylinder minus point five axis ninety left eye minus one point two five

trace.question: गेल्या दोन वर्षांत नंबर सारखा बदलत होता, म्हणून एकापेक्षा जास्त वेळा नवीन चष्मा करावा लागला का?
trace.questionEn: In the last two years, have you needed new glasses more than once because the power kept changing?
trace.reason: Power that keeps changing can signal a developing cataract or uncontrolled diabetes.

trace.question: दिवसभर जास्त करून काय काम करता? जसं की शेती, शिवणकाम, गाडी चालवणं, दुकान, ऑफिसचं किंवा कॉम्प्युटरचं काम, घरकाम, की शिक्षण?
trace.questionEn: What work do you do for most of the day? For example: farming, tailoring, driving, a shop, office or computer work, housework, or studies.
trace.reason: Work sets how many hours go to near, arm’s-length and far vision, the core of the vision profile.

trace.question: रोज साधारण किती तास जवळचं काम करता? वाचन, फोन, शिवणकाम किंवा बारीक हातकाम?
trace.questionEn: On a normal day, how many hours do you spend on close work: reading, the phone, sewing or fine handwork?
trace.reason: From the late 30s, hours of close work decide the reading add and the lens type.

trace.question: रोज किती तास कॉम्प्युटर किंवा लॅपटॉपवर काम करता?
trace.questionEn: How many hours a day do you work on a computer or laptop screen?
trace.reason: Screens sit at arm’s length ("intermediate" vision), which standard bifocals do not cover and progressives cover narrowly.

trace.question: रोज किती तास बाहेर, दिवसाच्या उजेडात असता?
trace.questionEn: How many hours a day are you outdoors in daylight?
trace.reason: Long hours in sunlight call for UV protection and possibly photochromic lenses.

trace.question: तुम्ही गाडी चालवता का? चारचाकी किंवा दुचाकी?
trace.questionEn: Do you drive a vehicle or ride a two-wheeler?
trace.reason: Driving needs sharp distance vision and wide side vision; it changes lens design and coating advice.

trace.question: रात्री समोरच्या गाड्यांच्या लाईटने किंवा रस्त्यावरच्या दिव्यांनी डोळे दिपतात का? किंवा रंग फिके, मळकट दिसतात का?
trace.questionEn: At night, do headlights or street lights dazzle you, or do colours look dull and faded?
trace.reason: Night glare for a driver calls for an anti-reflective coating.

trace.question: लेन्सवर साधारण किती खर्च करायचा आहे? हजार रुपयांपेक्षा कमी, एक ते तीन हजार, की तीन हजारांपेक्षा जास्त?
trace.questionEn: How much would you like to spend on the lenses: under one thousand rupees, one to three thousand, or more than three thousand?
trace.reason: Lens options for near-and-far needs range from low-cost bifocals to progressives; advice must be affordable to be followed.

trace.question: ಯಾವುದಾದ್ರೂ ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ದೃಷ್ಟಿ ಇದ್ದಕ್ಕಿದ್ದ ಹಾಗೆ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಆಯ್ತಾ? ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕೆಲವು ನಿಮಿಷದಲ್ಲಿ, ಗಂಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಇಲ್ಲಾ ಕೆಲವು ದಿನದಲ್ಲಿ? ತಿಂಗಳುಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಮೆಲ್ಲಮೆಲ್ಲಗೆ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಆಗೋದಲ್ಲ.

trace.question: ಈ ಕೆಲವು ವಾರದಲ್ಲೇ, ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಮುಂದೆ ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಮಿಂಚು ಕಾಣ್ಸೋಕೆ ಶುರು ಆಯ್ತಾ? ಇಲ್ಲಾ ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಚುಕ್ಕೆ, ಜೇಡರ ಬಲೆ ತರ ಏನೋ ತೇಲ್ತಾ ಕಾಣ್ತಿದ್ಯಾ? ಮುಂಚಿಂದ ಇರೋದಲ್ಲ, ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಬಂದಿದ್ದು.

trace.question: ಈ ಕೆಲವು ದಿನದಲ್ಲಿ, ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ತಾಗಿತಾ, ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಬಿತ್ತಾ, ಇಲ್ಲಾ ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಸಿಡಿದು ಬಿತ್ತಾ?

trace.question: ಶುಗರ್, ಬಿಪಿ, ಥೈರಾಯ್ಡ್ ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಇದ್ಯಾ?

trace.question: ಈ ಕನ್ನಡಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಕಾಣ್ಸುತ್ತೆ? ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದ್ಯಾ, ದೂರ ಮಸುಕಾ, ಹತ್ತಿರ ಮಸುಕಾ, ಇಲ್ಲಾ ತಲೆನೋವು ಬರುತ್ತಾ?

ನಮ್ ಸಲಹೆ: ಓದೋಕೆ ಕನ್ನಡಕ (add +2.75).
ಆಪ್ಟೋಮೆಟ್ರಿಸ್ಟ್ ಈ ರಿಸಲ್ಟ್ ನೋಡಿ, ನಿಮ್ ಕನ್ನಡಕ ಫೈನಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ.
ಇನ್ನೂ ಬೇಕಾಗಿರೋದು: ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಪ್ರೆಶರ್ (ಗ್ಲಾಕೋಮಾ) ಚೆಕಪ್.
ಸಲಹೆಗಳು: ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಕೆಲಸ ಇಲ್ಲಾ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ರೆ, ಪ್ರತಿ 20 ನಿಮಿಷಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದ್ಸಲ, 20 ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್ ಕಾಲ 6 ಮೀಟರ್ ದೂರ ನೋಡಿ. ಓದೋದು, ಹೊಲಿಗೆ ತರದ ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳ್ಳೇ ಬೆಳಕು ಇಟ್ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
ಈ ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ಅನ್ನ ಯಾವುದೇ ಕನ್ನಡಕದ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಾಗ್ಲೀ, ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಕ್ಯಾಂಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಾಗ್ಲೀ ತೋರಿಸಿ.

trace.question: உங்க வயசு என்னங்க?
trace.questionEn: How old are you?
trace.reason: Age sets which eye changes to look for: myopia in children, presbyopia after 40, cataract after 50.

trace.question: நீங்க பெண்ணுங்களா, ஆணுங்களா?
trace.questionEn: Are you female or male?
trace.reason: Needed for the record; some conditions differ by sex (angle-closure glaucoma is more common in women).

trace.question: இன்னைக்கு கண்ணுல என்ன பிரச்சனைங்க? உதாரணத்துக்கு: தூரம் சரியாத் தெரியல, பக்கத்துல படிக்க கஷ்டமா இருக்கு, தலைவலி இல்லனா கண்ணு சோர்வா இருக்கு, கண்ணு சிவப்பா இல்லனா வலியா இருக்கு, இல்லனா சும்மா செக்கப்.
trace.questionEn: What brings you here today? For example: can’t see far clearly, can’t read up close, headache or tired eyes, a red or painful eye, or just a check-up.
trace.reason: The main complaint decides which tests and follow-up questions matter.

trace.question: ஏதாவது ஒரு கண்ணுல பார்வை திடீர்னு குறைஞ்சிருக்குதா? அதாவது சில நிமிஷத்துல, சில மணி நேரத்துல, இல்லனா சில நாள்ல? மாசக் கணக்குல மெதுவா குறையுறது இல்ல.
trace.questionEn: Has the sight in either eye got worse suddenly, over minutes, hours or a few days? Not slowly over months.
trace.reason: A sudden drop (not a slow one) can be a detachment, a blocked blood vessel or an optic-nerve problem. When it started decides same day or within 48 hours.

trace.question: கடந்த சில வாரத்துக்குள்ளதான், கண்ணு முன்னாடி புதுசா மின்னல் மாதிரி தெரிய ஆரம்பிச்சிருக்கா? இல்லனா புதுசா நிறைய புள்ளிகள், சிலந்தி வலை மாதிரி மிதந்துட்டு தெரியுதா? ரொம்ப நாளா இருக்கிறது இல்ல, புதுசா வந்தது.
trace.questionEn: In the last few weeks, have you started seeing NEW flashes of light, or lots of new floating spots or cobwebs?
trace.reason: New flashes or floaters can come with a retinal tear (10-15% of cases): dilated retina check within 24 hours. Old floaters that have not changed are not a concern.
trace.raw: ஆமா மூணு நாளா கண்ணுக்குள்ள பூச்சி பறக்குற மாதிரி புள்ளி வருது

trace.question: பார்வையில ஒரு பகுதியை கருப்பு நிழலோ, திரையோ மறைச்ச மாதிரி, போகாம அப்படியே இருக்கா?
trace.questionEn: Is part of what you see covered by a dark shadow or curtain that does not go away?
trace.reason: A fixed shadow or curtain suggests a retinal detachment: eye hospital the same day.

trace.question: கடந்த சில வாரத்துக்குள்ள, புதுசா எல்லாமே ரெண்டு ரெண்டா தெரிய ஆரம்பிச்சிருக்கா?
trace.questionEn: In the last few weeks, have you started seeing double, two of everything?
trace.reason: New double vision can come from a nerve palsy or a stroke; double vision in one eye only is usually cataract or astigmatism.

trace.question: இப்போ ஏதாவது ஒரு கண்ணு சிவப்பா இல்லனா வலியா இருக்கா?
trace.questionEn: Is either eye red or painful right now?
trace.reason: Most red eyes are mild. Pain, blur, coloured rings or contact lenses make one urgent; the next question sorts which.

trace.question: கடந்த சில நாள்ல, கண்ணுல ஏதாவது அடிபட்டிருக்கா, கண்ணுல ஏதாவது விழுந்திருக்கா, இல்லனா தெறிச்சிருக்கா?
trace.questionEn: In the last few days, has anything hit the eye, gone into it, or splashed into it?
trace.reason: Chemical and high-speed injuries are emergencies; a scratch from a leaf or crop needs antibiotic ointment within 18 hours to prevent a fungal ulcer.

trace.question: சுகர், பிபி, தைராய்டு ஏதாவது இருக்கா?
trace.questionEn: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or a thyroid problem?
trace.reason: Diabetes damages the retina silently and makes glasses power fluctuate; blood pressure and thyroid disease also affect the eyes.

trace.question: உங்க அம்மா, அப்பா, அண்ணன் தம்பி, அக்கா தங்கச்சி யாருக்காவது கிளாக்கோமா இருக்கா? அதாவது கண் பிரஷர் நோய்.
trace.questionEn: Does your mother, father, brother or sister have glaucoma, the eye pressure disease?
trace.reason: Glaucoma runs in families and steals sight painlessly; relatives over 40 need an eye-pressure and optic-nerve check.

trace.question: உங்களுக்கு கேட்டராக்ட் (கண்புரை) ஆபரேஷனோ, வேற ஏதாவது கண் ஆபரேஷனோ பண்ணியிருக்காங்களா?
trace.questionEn: Have you had cataract surgery, or any other eye operation?
trace.reason: After cataract surgery the eye cannot focus up close, so near glasses are needed whatever the age.

trace.question: இப்போ கண்ணாடி போடுறீங்களா?
trace.questionEn: Do you wear glasses now?
trace.reason: Current glasses show the past prescription and what is or isn’t working.

trace.question: நாள்ல அதிகமா என்ன வேலை பண்றீங்க? உதாரணத்துக்கு: வயல் வேலை, தையல், வண்டி ஓட்டுறது, கடை, ஆபீஸ் இல்லனா கம்ப்யூட்டர் வேலை, வீட்டு வேலை, இல்லனா படிப்பு.
trace.questionEn: What work do you do for most of the day? For example: farming, tailoring, driving, a shop, office or computer work, housework, or studies.
trace.reason: Work sets how many hours go to near, arm’s-length and far vision, the core of the vision profile.

trace.question: சாதாரண நாள்ல, பக்கத்து வேலை எத்தனை மணி நேரம் பண்றீங்க? அதாவது படிக்கிறது, போன், தையல், இல்லனா சின்ன கை வேலை.
trace.questionEn: On a normal day, how many hours do you spend on close work: reading, the phone, sewing or fine handwork?
trace.reason: From the late 30s, hours of close work decide the reading add and the lens type.

trace.question: நீங்க வண்டி ஓட்டுவீங்களா? கார், ஆட்டோ, டூ-வீலர், எதுவா இருந்தாலும்?
trace.questionEn: Do you drive a vehicle or ride a two-wheeler?
trace.reason: Driving needs sharp distance vision and wide side vision; it changes lens design and coating advice.

trace.question: ராத்திரி நேரத்துல வண்டி லைட்டோ, தெரு லைட்டோ கண்ணைக் கூசுதா? இல்லனா கலர் வெளிறிப் போன மாதிரி தெரியுதா?
trace.questionEn: At night, do headlights or street lights dazzle you, or do colours look dull and faded?
trace.reason: Glare and faded colours after 50 are early cataract signs.

trace.question: லென்ஸுக்கு எவ்வளவு செலவு பண்ணலாம்னு இருக்கீங்க? ஆயிரம் ரூபாய்க்குள்ளயா, ஆயிரத்துல இருந்து மூவாயிரம் வரைக்குமா, இல்ல மூவாயிரத்துக்கு மேலயா?

trace.questionEn: Are you female or male?
trace.reason: Needed for the record; some conditions differ by sex (angle-closure glaucoma is more common in women).

trace.question: आज डोळ्यांना काय त्रास होतोय? जसं की लांबचं नीट दिसत नाही, जवळचं वाचता येत नाही, डोकं दुखतं किंवा डोळे थकतात, डोळा लाल आहे किंवा दुखतोय. की फक्त चेकअप करायचाय?
trace.questionEn: What brings you here today? For example: can’t see far clearly, can’t read up close, headache or tired eyes, a red or painful eye, or just a check-up.
trace.reason: The main complaint decides which tests and follow-up questions matter.

trace.question: एखाद्या डोळ्याने अचानक कमी दिसायला लागलंय का? म्हणजे काही मिनिटांत, काही तासांत किंवा काही दिवसांत? महिन्यांमध्ये हळूहळू कमी होत गेलं असेल, तर ते यात येत नाही.
trace.questionEn: Has the sight in either eye got worse suddenly, over minutes, hours or a few days? Not slowly over months.
trace.reason: A sudden drop (not a slow one) can be a detachment, a blocked blood vessel or an optic-nerve problem. When it started decides same day or within 48 hours.

trace.question: गेल्या काही आठवड्यांत, डोळ्यासमोर नवीनच प्रकाशाच्या चमका दिसायला लागल्यात का? किंवा बरेच नवीन ठिपके, कोळ्याच्या जाळ्यासारखं काही तरंगताना दिसायला लागलंय का?
trace.questionEn: In the last few weeks, have you started seeing NEW flashes of light, or lots of new floating spots or cobwebs?
trace.reason: New flashes or floaters can come with a retinal tear (10-15% of cases): dilated retina check within 24 hours. Old floaters that have not changed are not a concern.

trace.question: गेल्या काही आठवड्यांत दोन-दोन दिसायला लागलंय का? म्हणजे प्रत्येक गोष्ट दोन दिसते का?
trace.questionEn: In the last few weeks, have you started seeing double, two of everything?
trace.reason: New double vision can come from a nerve palsy or a stroke; double vision in one eye only is usually cataract or astigmatism.

trace.question: आत्ता एखादा डोळा लाल आहे का, किंवा दुखतोय का?
trace.questionEn: Is either eye red or painful right now?
trace.reason: Most red eyes are mild. Pain, blur, coloured rings or contact lenses make one urgent; the next question sorts which.

trace.question: यातलं काय काय आहे, ते सांगा. खरंच दुखतंय, फक्त खाज नाही? धूसर दिसतंय? दिव्याभोवती रंगीत गोल दिसतात? डोकं दुखतंय किंवा उलटी होतेय? उजेडाने डोळ्याला त्रास होतो? चिपडं, चिकट पाणी किंवा खाज? की तुम्ही कॉन्टॅक्ट लेन्स वापरता? यातलं काही नसेल, तर "काही नाही" म्हणा.
trace.questionEn: Which of these are there? Real pain, not just itching; blurred sight; coloured rings around lights; headache or vomiting; light hurts the eye; sticky discharge or itching; or do you wear contact lenses? Say none if nothing else.
trace.reason: Pain with coloured rings or vomiting: possible angle-closure (same day). Contact lenses: possible infection (same day). Pain or blur: within 24-48 hours. Only itching or discharge: usually conjunctivitis.

trace.question: गेल्या काही दिवसांत डोळ्याला काही लागलंय का? किंवा डोळ्यात काही गेलंय, किंवा उडालंय का?
trace.questionEn: In the last few days, has anything hit the eye, gone into it, or splashed into it?
trace.reason: Chemical and high-speed injuries are emergencies; a scratch from a leaf or crop needs antibiotic ointment within 18 hours to prevent a fungal ulcer.

trace.question: काय झालं होतं? चुना, ॲसिड किंवा साफसफाईचं लिक्विड असं काही केमिकल? हातोडा मारताना किंवा ग्राइंडिंग करताना उडालेला कण, किंवा काही टोकदार? बॉल, बुक्की किंवा काठीचा मार? की पान, पीक, ऊस, फांदी किंवा नखाने खरचटलं?
trace.questionEn: What was it? A chemical like lime (chuna), acid or a cleaner; a chip from hammering or grinding, or something sharp; a hit from a ball, fist or stick; or a scratch from a leaf, crop, branch or nail?
trace.reason: The kind of injury decides between rinse-and-hospital today and antibiotic ointment within 18 hours.

trace.question: शुगर, बीपी, थायरॉईड काही आहे का?
trace.questionEn: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or a thyroid problem?
trace.reason: Diabetes damages the retina silently and makes glasses power fluctuate; blood pressure and thyroid disease also affect the eyes.

trace.question: आत्ता चष्मा लावता का?
trace.questionEn: Do you wear glasses now?
trace.reason: Current glasses show the past prescription and what is or isn’t working.

trace.question: दिवसभर जास्त करून काय काम करता? जसं की शेती, शिवणकाम, गाडी चालवणं, दुकान, ऑफिसचं किंवा कॉम्प्युटरचं काम, घरकाम, की शिक्षण?
trace.questionEn: What work do you do for most of the day? For example: farming, tailoring, driving, a shop, office or computer work, housework, or studies.
trace.reason: Work sets how many hours go to near, arm’s-length and far vision, the core of the vision profile.

trace.question: रोज साधारण किती तास जवळचं काम करता? वाचन, फोन, शिवणकाम किंवा बारीक हातकाम?
trace.questionEn: On a normal day, how many hours do you spend on close work: reading, the phone, sewing or fine handwork?
trace.reason: From the late 30s, hours of close work decide the reading add and the lens type.

trace.question: तुम्ही गाडी चालवता का? चारचाकी किंवा दुचाकी?
trace.questionEn: Do you drive a vehicle or ride a two-wheeler?
trace.reason: Driving needs sharp distance vision and wide side vision; it changes lens design and coating advice.

trace.question: रात्री समोरच्या गाड्यांच्या लाईटने किंवा रस्त्यावरच्या दिव्यांनी डोळे दिपतात का? किंवा रंग फिके, मळकट दिसतात का?
trace.questionEn: At night, do headlights or street lights dazzle you, or do colours look dull and faded?
trace.reason: Night glare for a driver calls for an anti-reflective coating.
